comment: Duration law: linear mode returns the knob value in seconds, 0 to 10; logarithmic mode raises ten to a power spread from -3 to 1 across the knob, giving 1ms to 10 seconds (Miniramp.cpp:7-8 and 168-183). CV depth is in seconds per 10V and follows the same two laws (lines 187-202). The channel count at line 210 is written as inputs[CV_AMT_PARAM], which indexes the input list with a parameter id; the id happens to be 1 and input 1 is the CV jack, so the count is right by coincidence. The STOP input's channel count is not counted, matching the maker's statement that polyphony comes from TRG IN and CV. The four port lights are written from channel 0 only, which the maker marks as unfinished in a comment.
